notes: Both translations use the modern 150-Psalm numbering — Arabic source Arabic and English English do NOT use the Greek Septuagint Psalm numbering (which would split Pss 9 and 10, etc.). 148 of 150 Psalms align verse-for-verse.

Psalm 72: en v20 (the editorial colophon "The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended") is merged with v19's doxology into a single ar v19 in the Vulgate-derived Arabic source — so en v20 has no standalone ar equivalent.
Psalm 150: ar collapses en's v5 + v6 (the cymbals-and-everything-that-has-breath couplet) into a single ar v5. This is a Vulgate convention — Jerome treated it as one closing verse rather than two.
